description: Configure AIquila settings (API key, model, tokens, timeout, effort and thinking for chat and background tasks), and set up any LLM provider. Use targetProvider to configure a provider without making it the instance default; provider makes it the default. Run aiquila_show_config with targetProvider to list the setting ids a provider accepts.

effort.description: Default effort level; empty string resets to the model default

provider.description: Make this provider the instance default for every user (e.g. 'anthropic', 'mistral', 'hetzner', 'local'). Applied last, after its settings are accepted

providerKey.description: API key for the target provider

providerSettings.description: Other settings of the target provider by setting id or app config key, e.g. { local_base_url: 'http://llama:8080', timeout: '600' }. Validated like the admin settings page; access lists take comma-separated ids

targetProvider.description: Provider that providerKey, providerModel and providerSettings apply to, without changing the instance default. Defaults to provider, else anthropic

taskEffort.description: Effort for Assistant tasks and coworkers; empty string uses the default effort

taskThinking.description: Thinking for Assistant tasks and coworkers; empty string uses the default thinking

thinking.description: Default thinking: 'auto' follows the model (Fable, Opus 5.x and Sonnet 5 think on their own), 'on' or 'off'. Fable and Opus 5.5 always think.

name: aiquila_configure
title: Configure AIquila
